title: The Best and the Worst
question: Why is Joe's garden the most beautiful one in the town?
questionZh: 为什么乔的花园是镇上最漂亮的那一个？
text:
Why is Joe's garden the most beautiful one in the town?

Joe Sanders has the most beautiful garden in our town.
Nearly everybody enters for
'The Nicest Garden Competition' each year, but Joe wins every time.
Bill Frith's garden is larger than Joe's.
Bill works harder than Joe and grows more flowers and vegetables, but Joe's garden is more interesting.
He has made neat paths and has built a wooden bridge over a pool.
I like gardens too, but I do not like hard work.
Every year
I enter for the garden competition too, and I always win a little prize for the worst garden in the town!
bodyText:
Joe Sanders has the most beautiful garden in our town.
Nearly everybody enters for
'The Nicest Garden Competition' each year, but Joe wins every time.
Bill Frith's garden is larger than Joe's.
Bill works harder than Joe and grows more flowers and vegetables, but Joe's garden is more interesting.
He has made neat paths and has built a wooden bridge over a pool.
I like gardens too, but I do not like hard work.
Every year
I enter for the garden competition too, and I always win a little prize for the worst garden in the town!
bodyTextZh:
乔·桑德斯拥有最美丽的花园。在我们镇上。
几乎每个人都参加
“最美丽花园竞赛”但是乔每次都能赢。
比尔·弗里斯的花园比乔的大。
比尔比乔工作更努力。并且能种植出更多的鲜花和蔬菜。不过乔的花园更有趣。
他修了整洁的小路还在池塘上建了一座木桥。
我也喜欢花园。但我不喜欢辛苦的工作。
每年
我也会参加花园比赛。而且我总能赢得一个小奖品。因为镇上最差的花园！
